summary: Confirmed cause: channel transmit was off. Owner did not use the marine template; he found channel 16 with transmit set OFF, turned it ON, re-wrote, and the radio now transmits on 156.800 MHz. Radio and write path are fine. Open: where the TX-off came from (NewChirp shows Duplex 'off' as 'TX off'; source of his channels unknown). The receive-only write note (7014d58d) covers every source.
